spec.moment: Eating clam chowder in a bread bowl on the wharf while sea lions bark below and surfers ride the waves in the afternoon sun.

elements.name: clam chowder in a bread bowl
elements.look: a round sourdough bowl filled with creamy white chowder, a wooden spoon resting in it, sitting on a weathered wooden table

elements.name: sea lions
elements.look: three glossy brown sea lions with whiskered snouts, mouths open mid-bark, heaped on a floating wooden dock

elements.name: surfers
elements.look: a few tiny figures in dark wetsuits on bright boards, standing in the surf at the back edge

elements.name: rented bikes
elements.look: two cheerful red cruiser bikes leaning together

elements.name: Maya
elements.look: a small simple figure in a yellow sundress and sun hat, seated across the table

elements.name: wharf planks
elements.look: sun-warmed gray wooden planks with rope railings and weathered pilings at the edge

spec.scene: A sun-warmed wooden wharf patch with rope railings, the cream chowder in its bread bowl on a small table at the center, a wooden spoon in it. Maya in a yellow sundress sits across from it, and two red cruiser bikes lean at the left. At the right edge, three brown sea lions crowd a floating dock, mouths open. At the back edge, tiny wetsuited surfers stand in painted blue surf, and a low slice of pale cliff rises behind them. Afternoon light glows gold on the planks.
spec.title: Chowder on the Wharf
spec.caption: Fog burned off, sea lions yelling, chowder in a bread bowl with Maya.
